_about: How the lenses resolve a stored name to the addresses it reaches. A name's DNS relations (purpose dns in the semantics table) lead to an address when the other end is one of address_types, and to another name when the record type is one of alias_rr_types: a CNAME makes its owner an alias of the target, whose records apply instead (RFC 1034 section 3.6.2). delegation_rr_types are the records that delegate a zone to name servers (NS, RFC 1034 section 4.2.1). mail_rr_types are the records naming a domain's mail servers (MX, RFC 5321 section 5.1). max_alias_depth bounds an alias chain; resolvers bound them too, since a chain can loop (RFC 1034 section 5.3.2). record_type_names maps a stored record's numeric RR type to the label the lenses show; a type absent from the map is shown as TYPE<number>. Add values here, not in Go code.
